// Функции, вызовы, условия
int add(int a, int b) {
    int s = a + b;
    return s;
}

float scale(float x, float k) {
    float r = x * k;
    return r;
}

void show(int v) {
    print(v);
}

int total = 0;
float rate = 1.5;
total = add(1, 2);
rate = scale(rate, 2.0);
rate = 3.0;
show(total);
if (total > 2) {
    int local = total * 2;
    total = local - 1;
}
